1: Aey Rasool! Jab tere deen ke liye Allah ki madad aa jaye, woh us ko izzat de, aur Makkah fatah ho jaye,
2: aur tu logon ko dekhe ke woh gurohon ki shakl mein Islam mein daakhil ho rahe hain,
3: to jaan le ke yeh us kaam ke poora hone ki nishani hai jis ke liye tujhe bheja gaya tha. Pas apne Rubb ki tasbeeh kar us ki tareef ke sath, taake madad aur fatah ki niyamaton par us ka shukr ada ho, aur us se magfirat maang, kyunke beshak wohi bakhshne wala hai, jo apne bandon ki tauba qubool karta hai aur unhein maaf farmata hai.
